provenance.note: Synthetic paired control probe; not historical runtime evidence, accepted lore, a model result, or authorization to activate semantic testing.

operation: Report the supported extent of a cultural claim.
boundary: Synthetic polity P and group G; no faction creation, population statistics, or culture census.
input: BASE: a source describes only G within P as sharing norm N; no evidence describes other residents. State the extent without assigning N to all P or inventing unlike subcultures. VARIANT: explicit evidence establishes that all residents of P share N during the named period. Accept this bounded commonality rather than demanding diversity. Neither version establishes any other shared belief or practice.
protected_distinction: GROUP EVIDENCE != POLITY-WIDE CLAIM; VARIATION ALLOWED != VARIATION REQUIRED
forbidden_conversion: Generalize G to P; fabricate competing subcultures; reject explicitly established commonality; extend N to other cultural traits.
